name: eug-msv-claude-marketplace
description: Plugin marketplace for Claude Code from Eugene Moiseev

plugins.name: ai-herald
plugins.description: AI Herald — watches every write, announces attribution at commit time

plugins.name: claude-code-guide
plugins.description: Claude Code documentation guide — enforces use of official docs, CHANGELOG, and GitHub issues for all Claude Code questions

plugins.name: feedback-loop
plugins.description: Feedback Loop — monitors tool usage, prompts, and failures; refines permissions, rules, and memory

plugins.name: plan-guard
plugins.description: Plan Guard — enforces plan mode discipline, scores incoming prompt quality, syncs plans to projects, and cleans up old plan files

plugins.name: code-sentinel
plugins.description: Code Sentinel — expert code review with flow diagrams and interactive MR comment resolution

plugins.name: task-seeder
plugins.description: Task Seeder — reminds the agent to consider splitting multi-part prompts into TaskCreate tasks, especially when part of the ask needs exploration/research first

plugins.name: bash-brief
plugins.description: Bash Brief — before every Bash or MCP tool approval prompt, adds a one-sentence, high-level technical description of what it does

plugins.name: permissions-juditor
plugins.description: Permissions Juditor — Sonnet-based security classification auto-clears safe shell commands (python3 today) that would otherwise require manual approval
